title.narrative: Strengthen Educational Management Information Systems (EMIS) through Digital Solutions to better deliver on SDG 4 and related targets

description.narrative: Summary Description Digital innovation has demonstrated its capacity to complement, enrich, and fundamentally transform education, offering a potent catalyst to accelerate progress towards Sustainable Development Goal 4 for education while transforming approaches to universal learning access. This transformative potential extends to enhancing the quality and relevance of learning experiences, fostering inclusivity, and fortifying educational administration and governance. Despite decades of education policy focus in Latin America and the Caribbean on improving the quality and computerization of education data, as well as fostering evidence-based decision-making cultures, significant challenges persist. Many countries in the region find themselves with Educational Management Information Systems (EMIS) that lack intentional design, instead comprising a patchwork of loosely connected applications and platforms—some digitized, others manual—resulting from disparate projects or initiatives. Furthermore, the prevailing trend of siloed development within education systems has led to fragmented information systems, hindering cohesive data management and utilization efforts. (OREALC/UNESCO Santiago, 2021). This workplan aims to Strengthen Educational Management Information Systems and the effective use of Digital Solutions to better deliver on SDG 4 and related targets.
